name: Being Healthy
overview: Scripture reveals that being healthy is intimately connected to honoring God as the Creator of mankind, made in His image (Genesis 1:27) and intricately formed in the womb (Psalms 139:13). God promises healing and protection from disease when His commands are obeyed with a sincere heart (Exodus 15:26). Furthermore, living in reverent fear of the Lord contributes to longevity (Proverbs 10:27), and believers are called to offer their bodies as holy, living sacrifices, reflecting a life devoted to God’s service and care (Romans 12:1). This holistic view underscores that physical health is part of faithful stewardship of the body entrusted to us by God.
